_doc: Where the town is founded (Systems/Founding.cs). New game offers `offered` sites for the seed: the default first, then others whose `near` themes (if any) lie within `within` rings. The chosen site shapes the country round the town (sea: a sector of open water from `bearing` turned by the seed, `arc` wide, from `inner` days out to at most `outer`, kept clear of sites; flank: high peaks either side of the road out; drop: the land falls away below the town, for the client) and its numbers: defence adds to the walls' fortification, trade multiplies caravan earnings, yields multiply what farms, camps and quarries bring in, watch adds watchmen at the charter, keep 'garrison' starts a keep beside the hall and 'ruin' turns the nearest site into the old keep (`ruin`, a Ruins kind) to clear and restore ('either' picks by seed). The sites not chosen are not lost: each stands on the same map, held by the nearest neighbour settlement (`held`) or by foes (`foes`) when no settlement is near. Default changes nothing, so the gate's campaigns stay as they were.

ruin.gives: stands over the town again, and the town's defence rises
ruin.text: The council roofs {site} again, hangs a banner from its tower and puts a garrison behind its gate. The town's old keep is its own once more.

kinds.name: River ford
kinds.blurb: Flat meadows at a ford on the river road. Good soil, easy roads, nothing to hide behind.
kinds.held: {name} grew up at a ford on the river road.
kinds.foes: Raiders camp at the old ford and toll whoever crosses.

kinds.name: Sea cove
kinds.blurb: A sheltered cove where the land meets the sea. Boats carry your companies along the coast; less good farmland.
kinds.held: {name} has grown up round a sheltered sea cove, its boats drawn up on the shingle.
kinds.foes: Wreckers hold the sea cove and light false lamps on stormy nights.

kinds.name: Island
kinds.blurb: An island reached by a tidal causeway. Easy to hold, slow to supply; boats take companies across.
kinds.held: {name} stands on an island off the shore, its causeway under water twice a day.
kinds.foes: Something has taken the island off the shore: no boat that goes out comes back.

kinds.name: Crag castle
kinds.blurb: A rock above the plain with a fallen castle on it. Strong ground, thin soil, and a keep to win back.
kinds.held: {name} keeps a castle on a crag above the plain, with an aqueduct running up to it.
kinds.foes: Brigands hold the old crag castle and watch the plain from its towers.

kinds.name: Cliff plateau
kinds.blurb: A high plateau ringed with cliffs, one ramp up. Raiders struggle with the climb; so do the carts.
kinds.held: {name} sits on a cliff plateau, joined to its fields by rope bridges.
kinds.foes: Raiders hold a cliff plateau and haul their spoils up on ropes.

kinds.name: Desert cliff city
kinds.blurb: Houses cut into a sandstone cliff over a dry valley, an oasis below. Rich caravans, scarce food and wood.
kinds.held: {name} is carved into a sandstone cliff above an oasis.
kinds.foes: Sand raiders have taken a cliff city and its oasis, and charge caravans for water.

kinds.name: Ledge above the clouds
kinds.blurb: A shelf high on a mountain, above the cloud. Nearly impossible to attack; farms struggle in the thin air.
kinds.held: {name} clings to a ledge above the clouds, where airships tie up to its towers.
kinds.foes: Harpies nest on a ledge above the clouds and drop on anyone climbing.

kinds.name: Pass keep
kinds.blurb: A keep in a mountain pass on the old road. Every traveller pays the toll; some years the keep is manned, some years a ruin.
kinds.held: {name} holds the keep in the mountain pass and takes the toll.
kinds.foes: A warlord holds the keep in the mountain pass and takes the toll at spear-point.
